sources.independence: Commercial supplier summarising mechanic/owner reports; no quantified failure rate.

findings: Check scuttle-water entry and ECU connectors, EGR/DPF history, cold-start chain noise and higher-gear bearing whine. The supplier identifies these as reported generation/engine issues; they do not prove this advert has a fault.
seller_questions: Any cold-start chain rattle or fifth/sixth-gear whine?
Invoices for EGR/DPF work and any scuttle-water or ECU repairs?
inspection_priorities: Cold start, loaded road test and gearbox noise; inspect scuttle seals and ECU connections.

sources.independence: Supplier reports a specific CFCA failure mechanism and sells replacement components; not fleet incidence data.

findings: Specialist reports early EGR-cooler corrosion associated with severe engine wear and oil consumption on CFCA. Confirm engine code and documented engine/cooler history; do not generalise this to all 2.0 TDI engines.
seller_questions: Confirmed engine code, measured oil consumption and invoices for engine/EGR-cooler replacement?
inspection_priorities: Independent VW specialist review of oil consumption, engine condition and EGR-cooler revision before pursuing.

sources.independence: Workshop maintenance guidance, not failure-frequency research.

findings: Workshop distinguishes 3.0 HDi chain-driven timing from belt-driven variants; chain condition still requires inspection. Confirm exact engine and gearbox before applying generation-specific reliability conclusions.
seller_questions: Any documented cold-start chain noise or timing-system work? Confirm engine code and gearbox.
inspection_priorities: Cold start and service-invoice review; do not assume a chain makes the drivetrain maintenance-free.

sources.independence: Buyer guide with variant-specific faults, not a population reliability estimate.

findings: Haynes identifies injector-related fluctuating idle on 2006–2011 2.2 TDCi 115 variants. Confirm build year and power before applying this issue.
seller_questions: Confirmed power/build year; injector diagnosis or replacement invoices and stable cold/hot idle?
inspection_priorities: Cold/hot idle and injection-system diagnosis if symptoms are present.
